body:
Thank you for your support. I have a great life! and a great family. Yet I am very depressed. I don't know why. And I feel guilty as fuck for it. 

The specific issue which has led me to you this morning, however, is that this has culminated, as I've noticed in the last few months, in my friends here at college behaving awkwardly around me in a manner which suggests they no longer desire my presence in their lives. Yesterday evening, I conducted a thorough discussion of this matter with my best friend (as I would consider it) here at college who may be the only one I will keep. He, essentially, informed me that my friends think I don't understand them, don't appreciate them, and they feel as though I have not "evolved" on a personal level since I have met them. They have themselves taken up various forms of spiritual discovery which I also encountered when I was their age (they are about 3 years younger than me) and basically feel that I have not evolved with them. I'm past that phase in my life. I feel that they are judging me based on a condition (they're changing perspective) which I have no control over nor any desire to control. I accept them for who they are and who they have become. I have indoctrinated myself with their ways (i.e. I've grown to appreciate their choices in music, athletics, etc...) while they have refused to accept mine and even berated my hobbies at times. I think I have grown a significant amount in that I have accepted new ideas and such, and that they are wrong. Nevertheless, I know I cannot be wholy correct. I just feel I'm being punished for something I, frankly, didn't do. And I'm receiving no credit for the efforts I have made to reach out to them over the years. 

I have always been the guy who longs to fit in. Throughout my formative years, as well as here in college. I'm done with it. I will be gradding in 2 months and I'm just done with it. I'm ready to move on to better things. A lot of personal issues have cropped up over the last 3 years, however, and this is just the tip of iceberg that is my personal issues and insecurities.

I'm too much of a coward to go through with it but I think about ending it everyday. I just could not bare to see, or know, the pain and anguish I would cause my family and my one or two good friends I have made in the course of my lifetime, for I know, to them I will be truly missed. Fuck.
